company.description: OjrahApp is an all-in-one platform for taxi management, fully integrated with TGA regulations for complete compliance management. It streamlines operations by managing vehicle provision, hardware installation, insurance, and maintenance. Combining fleet management, dispatching, and ERP features into a user-friendly interface, OjrahApp enhances operational efficiency and reduces costs for taxi companies.
